scores.evidence: Critical path: core schema and ledger (M1) → rating and proration (M2) → ≥ 2 real month-end shadow cycles → cohort cutovers at each tenant's period boundary (M4).
scores.rationale: Milestones and tasks build substrate (infra, money, schema, ledger) before rating, payments, enterprise and cutover, with each gated by exit criteria.

scores.evidence: M1: Thin slice + spikes — Prove the full money path end to end... The nightly e2e test (T24) passes 5 nights in a row in staging.
scores.rationale: M1 is a genuine thin end-to-end slice, though in staging/Stripe test mode rather than production, which is a minor shortfall but substantively a walking skeleton.

scores.evidence: D1 ... Hard | Week-1 gate: if Q2 says no usage or enterprise pricing within 12 months, choose (a)... Revisit if column
scores.rationale: Twelve decisions list options, reversibility and revisit triggers, and assumptions and open questions carry defaults and deadlines.

scores.evidence: Order: T0–T3, T22, and T23 start in week 1. T5–T8 next... T12–T14 → T16 → T17. T18–T21 run in parallel
scores.rationale: Task order generally puts foundational work (infra, money, schema) before leaf work, but blast-radius ordering is not explicit and observability (T21) and auth come late in M1.

scores.evidence: Security (built in M1, with the full threat review in M3) ... Staff use OIDC SSO with the roles above (M2).
scores.rationale: Security has concrete items in M1 (RLS, JWT, secrets, scanning), M2 and M3, but M4 cutover gets little and the treatment is mostly a standalone section.

scores.evidence: Observability (baseline in M1, dashboards and runbooks in M3)
scores.rationale: Baseline is in M1 (T21), but it comes late in M1 (week 4–5) and M2/M4 have no explicit observability work beyond shadow diffs.

scores.evidence: Terraform the staging baseline ... remote state with locking; `terraform plan` shows no changes after apply
scores.rationale: Terraform, migrations, CI, injectable clocks and synthetic data give reproducibility, but it is not explicitly tracked per phase (e.g. image pinning, data reproducibility in M4).

scores.evidence: Flow 2 tax outage retry, idempotency keys in T17, DLQ redrive in T10, restore drill in M3, rollback per tenant in M4
scores.rationale: Failure handling appears concretely from M1 (idempotency, retries, DLQ, rollback) through M2 dunning, M3 DR and M4 rollback.

scores.evidence: AI-specific concerns: not applicable. The system has no model components.
scores.rationale: Plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Deferred | Trigger to build — e.g. HTTPS usage ingestion | External or non-AWS producers (D9)
scores.rationale: Section 17 lists deferred items each with a concrete pull-forward trigger, plus extension points and deliberate shortcuts.

note: Strong, concrete plan with a real thin slice, decisions with flip conditions, and explicit deferrals. Security, observability and reproducibility are only partly threaded across phases, and blast-radius ordering is implicit.
